BiblicalUsage: ʼEshʻân was a town in the hill country of Judah. The name occurs once, in Joshua. There is no People profile for it, because it is a place, not a person.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe ʼEshʻân matters because Scripture bothered to record the name. That is enough reason to slow down and notice the name rather than skip it.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
